requirement: When `output.html.git-repository-url` names a GitHub repository and `output.html.edit-url-template` uses that repository's `/edit/<branch>/{path}` form, each safely resolved source location displayed for an evidence input MUST link its repository-relative file and inclusive line range to `/blob/<branch>/<file>#L<start>-L<end>`. A source location MUST remain plain text when a safe URL cannot be derived. A generated detail page MUST use its evidence JSON file as the mdBook edit target when the file exists, or its requirement chapter when the evidence file is missing.
rationale: The sources satisfy `requirements.index.source_links`. The implementation covers every obligation, and the tests cover the main points in the design space. **Implementation (`src/index.rs`)** - `SourceLinks::from_config` returns `None` unless `output.html.git-repository-url` is `https://github.com//`. It validates the owner and project characters. It also requires `edit-url-template` to be exactly `/edit//{path}` with a non-empty branch. It then stores `/blob/` as the prefix. - `input_url` builds `/#L-L`: - It percent-encodes each path segment through `encode_url_segment`. - It returns `None` for parent or absolute components, an empty path, a zero start line, or an end before the start. Together these make up the "safe" check. - `render_source_location` emits `file:start–end` when a URL exists, and plain `` text otherwise. It escapes the HTML in both cases. - `render_input` calls `render_source_location` for each resolved range. Unresolved or stale inputs show no source location, so nothing unsafe is linked. - Edit target: - `DetailPlan::populate` sets each detail page's `source_path` to `evidence_edit_path(...)` (`../evidence/.json` relative to `book.src`) when the evidence file exists. - Otherwise it uses the requirement's defining chapter path, `definition.path`. - The `{impl}` markers are on all of these functions. They are also on the `lib.rs` `preprocess_book` block, which is only loosely related. **Tests** - `source_links_use_configured_repository_and_branch` checks: - a custom branch (`release`); - the exact `blob/release/src/evidence.rs#L26-L37` URL; - percent-encoding of spaces and `#`; - rejection of `../outside.rs` and a start line of 0; - `evidence_edit_path` with a nested `book.src`; - an end-to-end `render_detail_page` call with a real outline input, producing the exact anchor HTML; - `None` when the template repository differs from the configured one; - `None` for a `javascript:` URL. - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` checks both edit-target branches. An existing evidence file gives `../evidence/requirements.core.ready.json`. A missing one gives `requirements/core.md`. **Minor untested corners** These are not enough to fail the requirement. - An end line before the start line. - A trailing slash on the repository URL. - The rendered plain-text fallback when no links are configured.
